scripts.dev: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('lsof -ti:4000,3010 | xargs kill -9',{stdio:'ignore'})}catch{}" && concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.quickDev: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('lsof -ti:4000,3010 | xargs kill -9',{stdio:'ignore'})}catch{}" && concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "CACHE_ONLY_SCRAPING=1 npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.reloadCache: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('lsof -ti:4000,3010 | xargs kill -9',{stdio:'ignore'})}catch{}" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const scrapeMainPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'server/src/scraping/core/main/ScrapeJobMain.ts');const cacheTargetsPath=path.join(process.cwd(),'server/cache/cachesNeedUpdating.json');const source=fs.readFileSync(scrapeMainPath,'utf8');const names=[...source.matchAll(/name:\s*'([^']+)'/g)].map((m)=>m[1]);const uniqueNames=[...new Set(names)];if(uniqueNames.length===0){throw new Error('No scraper component names found in ScrapeJobMain.ts');}fs.writeFileSync(cacheTargetsPath,JSON.stringify(uniqueNames,null,2)+'\n','utf8');console.log('Prepared '+uniqueNames.length+' cache refresh target(s).');" && concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
